results.title: LUPIN THE IIIRD: The Movie - The Immortal Bloodline
results.original_title: LUPIN THE IIIRD THE MOVIE 不死身の血族
results.overview: After fending off a series of skilled assassins, gentleman thief Lupin III and his band of allies follow a strange invitation to an uncharted island. When their plane is shot down, the gang is stranded and soon hunted by the island’s inhabitants, past enemies, and a monstrous immortal being known as Muom, who threatens to destroy Lupin's legacy. As a deadly toxic fog settles over them, Lupin must confront his greatest enemy in his most daring escapade yet.

results.title: Mein Surname
results.overview: David J. Hitler, burdened by his notorious surname, attempts to prove he's a good person but quickly discovers that redemption is a harder sell than infamy.

results.title: Pavements
results.overview: '90s indie-rock band Pavement reunites for their sold-out 2022 tour. But as preparations get underway, surreal tributes emerge: an off-Broadway musical adaptation of their songs, a museum devoted entirely to the band’s legacy, and a shamelessly awards-baiting Hollywood biopic.

results.title: The Musicians
results.overview: Astrid Thompson finally succeeds in fulfilling her father's dream: to bring together four Stradivarius for a unique concert, eagerly expected by music lovers around the world. But Lise, George, Peter and Apolline, the four virtuosos recruited for the occasion, are incapable of playing together. The rehearsals are one ego crisis after another. With no solution in sight, Astrid decides to go and find the only person who, in her eyes, can still save the event: Charlie Beaumont, the composer of the score.

results.title: Kites
results.overview: In a magical realist world where you can have a conversation with your guardian angel, Duvo, a 25-year-old gangster, searches for peace and redemption from a life marked by crime in this beautifully lyrical look at life in the favelas of Rio de Janeiro.

results.title: Rombengan
results.overview: An ustaz is ashamed of his father's business, a 'bundle' shop near the alley of immorality, and is worried that it will affect his reputation.

results.title: Missing: Keti Harayeko Suchana
results.overview: A gripping tale of two young people from contrasting worlds who are thrust together by a twist of fate. A man from Nepal's Terai plains accidentally abducts a woman from the northern hills, bringing her to his rural village in Janakpur. What begins as a clash of personalities slowly transforms into a journey of shared understanding, bridging deep-seated social and cultural divides.

results.title: The Forbidden City
results.overview: The son of an indebted restaurant owner joins a foreign girl in search of her sister. Together, they’ll have to fight side by side against the most ruthless members of the Roman criminal underworld.

results.title: Horror Vacui
results.overview: Two sisters, Silvia and Susanna, are divided by a deep conflict. Susanna, considered unstable but convinced of her own clarity, accuses Silvia of having an incestuous relationship with their father, shattering the family's balance. Her provocative and violent actions make her socially dangerous and force her to disappear. Meanwhile, her accusations contaminate everyone's relationships, leaving behind an ambiguous reality in which the truth appears painful and uncertain.

Octavio and Adela were born on the same day, April 14th, 1931. During the following 8 decades, their lives will intertwine through intense encounters and misunderstandings in 8 episodes. A passionate love story between a brave and fighting woman and a man confronted with his contradictions. They will have to face coming from families on opposing sides of a country slowly heading towards a Civil War, along with the history of Spain and Europe as a background.

results.title: Court: State vs. A Nobody
results.overview: A determined lawyer takes on a high-stakes case to defend a 19-year-old boy, challenging a system that has already branded him guilty.

results.title: Forced Vacation
results.overview: Following a booking error, two families who are complete opposites, as well as a somewhat snobbish publisher and the influencer he wants to publish, are forced to share a sublime vacation home. The culture clash is immediate, between incompatible habits and strong personalities. Yet, despite the tensions and misunderstandings, this forced vacation takes an unexpected turn and turns out to be an adventure full of surprises and laughter.

results.title: Into Reality
results.overview: A troubled man keeps seeing an image he can't get out of his head. The answers may be more than he realizes.

results.title: Malice
results.overview: A company of six people decides to go to a hut in the forest, but soon real evil joins them, and now the company will have to try hard to survive.

results.title: Tee Yai: Born to Be Bad
results.original_title: ตี๋ใหญ่ ฤกษ์ดาวโจร
results.overview: In 1980s Bangkok, a wily thief stages a series of daring heists, baffling the authorities and the public — until one cop sets out to take him down.

results.title: Trapped
results.overview: A ship sinks off West Africa. Everyone aboard drowns, except the cook. Trapped in a small air pocket with water up to his neck, he faces a slow death as oxygen dwindles.  This extraordinary documentary follows untrained diver Nico’s daring mission to save him.  After miraculously finding the cook alive after three days, Nico faces his biggest challenge yet: navigating narrow, deadly passages to bring him to safety.  Told through authentic footage and audio from divers' helmet cams, this film showcases heroism, hope, and friendship, proving miracles can still happen.

results.title: El Mariano
results.overview: This short film shot in Tepic revives his spirit in a former wrestler who bursts into the public square, unleashing a viral storm. He doesn't ask for land, he doesn't proclaim himself a leader... he just shouts.

results.title: Closing Time
results.overview: Micro drama adapted from a playlet called Korban Bulan Madu

results.title: Red Plague
results.overview: Following the sudden and traumatic loss of his family in the early days of a virulent plague, Carter retreats into the desert, hiding away from what remains of the world. But when a lost girl arrives at his door seeking help, he must confront old wounds and find a way to finally heal... Or bleed out.

results.title: Skill Issue
results.overview: Simon spends a summer day by the river with Enes's clique, whom he knows from the neighborhood. Between moments of uncertainty and sluggish conversations, the hours slip by. But then Marie shows up and Simon is suddenly wide awake.
